Description
Bullion Trading LLC is pleased to introduce the
1 oz PAMP Suisse Lunar Tiger Gold Bar (In Assay)
. PAMP Suisse created this
1 oz gold bar
to commemorate 2022 as the Chinese lunar calendar’s Year of the Tiger. This lunar gold bar exemplifies PAMP’s reputation for beautiful, high-quality investments. This new 2022 Year of the Tiger bar is the third in the 12-year Chinese Zodiac cycle and joins the highly regarded
PAMP Lunar Series
. This beautiful PAMP Suisse gold bar contains one troy ounce of 99.999 fine gold and is sealed in a red CertiPAMP assay. For easy certification, the card displays a unique serial number that matches the one found engraved on the bar.
PAMP Suisse’s Chinese Zodiac Series
began in 2012 with the release of Year of the Dragon bars and has continued to the present day with the production of
Year of the Tiger bars
. Those born under the energizing sign of the tiger are regarded as captivating, daring, self-assured, active, and adventurous. The Tiger zodiac has had recent years like 1962, 1974, 1986, 1998, and 2010. This 1 oz Gold Bar Lunar Tiger PAMP Suisse will be an outstanding addition to any
precious metal
investor’s portfolio or a terrific present for anyone born in the Year of the Tiger, so grab yours today!
Design of 1 Oz Gold Bar Pamp Suisse Lunar Year of the Tiger
Individual packaging is included with each
1 oz Gold Bar PAMP Suisse Lunar Tiger.
The
gold bars
are packaged in protective blister cards with the Lunar Calendar Series designs. The crimson card has a Lunar Calendar-themed border in the corners, the date of issue, and the title of this installment in the series. The authentication facts on the backside of the card contain the matching weight, purity, metal composition, and unique serial number.
The obverse of
Lunar Tiger Gold Bar 1 oz PAMP Suisse
depicts a gigantic tiger waiting in a tree for its meal. Tigers are not as commonly linked with tree climbing as some smaller species of large cats, such as the leopard. In this design, though, the tiger starts to descend from the front of the tree from a Y in its trunk. This field contains the Chinese tiger emblem. Inscriptions, including the kanji for “Tiger,” can also be seen.
The opposing views of this artwork may be found on the backside of the
1 oz Gold Bar PAMP Suisse Lunar Year of the Tiger
. As the Tiger continues to descend the other side of the tree, you can see more of the Y-shaped intersection of the tree trunk. On this side, you’ll find the PAMP Suisse logo, the weight, purity, and metal content, as well as the serial number.
Additionally, we have,
100 Gram Gold Bar – PAMP Suisse
&
2.5 Gram Gold Bar – PAMP Suisse Lady Fortuna
.
Main Highlights of 1 Oz Gold Bar Lunar Tiger Pamp Suisse
Contains 1 Troy oz of .9999 pure gold.
Every gold bar comes with a gorgeous red assay card that confirms a certified assayer has approved the bar.
Obverse: The front view of a tiger preparing to climb down from a towering tree, alertly staring ahead, is depicted. Inscriptions: The Chinese character for Tiger, “虎”, can also be found on this side, just above the tree.
Reverse: The back view of a tiger going down a tree is shown. Inscriptions: The serial number, weight, and purity of the bar, as well as the PAMP Suisse logo.
The red assay card contains a serial number that matches the one on each Gold Year of the Tiger bar, ensuring the weight and purity of these PAMP Gold Bars.
